name: Mumbaiya Mix Mouth Freshener-180gm
original_description:
Mumbaiya Mix Mouth Freshener – 180g | A Taste of Mumbai’s Street Soul

Savor the vibrant essence of Mumbai’s iconic street corners with Mumbaiya Mix Mouth Freshener — a thoughtfully curated blend of natural ingredients rooted in the city’s beloved culinary traditions. This aromatic mix invites you to experience a symphony of sweet, tangy, spicy, and savory notes, crafted to delight the senses and honor time-honored flavors.

Each spoonful reflects the authenticity of generations-old preparations — made with whole, minimally processed ingredients, free from artificial additives, preservatives, or refined sugars. No shortcuts. Just the pure, unadulterated character of nature’s harvest.

A Flavor Journey, Inspired by the Streets:
- Sweet Undertones: Candied fennel seeds and dried fruits offer a gentle, naturally sweet note — echoing the warmth of roadside favorites.
- Tangy Brightness: Tamarind and other natural souring agents bring a lively, refreshing lift — reminiscent of classic chaat stalls.
- Spice Nuances: A subtle blend of aromatic spices adds depth and character, enhancing the sensory experience without overpowering.
- Savory Crunch: Roasted seeds and nuts provide a satisfying texture, grounding the mix with earthy richness and natural integrity.

Ideal for moments after meals, between tea breaks, or as a mindful pause in your day — Mumbaiya Mix is an invitation to slow down, savor, and connect with the rhythm of tradition.

180g of Pure, Natural Flavor — No Preservatives. No Artificial Additives. Just Authentic Taste.

Crafted by ZAARAH Herbals | Available exclusively at Falcon Herbs
